summary: Josh Lloyd and Ryland Styles of Locked On Thunder preview the Oklahoma City Thunder's 2026/27 season. They focus on health, especially Jalen Williams and Ajay Mitchell, and on the offseason exits of Lu Dort, Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins. Those trades were made mainly to cut the luxury tax bill, with unproven rookies and young players coming in as replacements. Ryland expects a step back in the regular season to about 62 wins, with OKC and San Antonio still the top two seeds in the West. Other topics are Cason Wallace's role as the likely starter in Dort's spot, Ajay Mitchell's shooting splits as a starter versus off the bench, the team's internal belief in Jared McCain, and Chet Holmgren bouncing back from a poor series. Both hosts note how few threes the Thunder's core players take, and Ryland says the team may push them to shoot more.
